description: This function is used to get columnar report. Part of the Columnar Report APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

sort.description: Sort direction. Allowed values: asc, desc. Default: asc. Optional.

count.description: Page size (number of items returned). Default: 20. Optional.

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; omit for default company branch behaviour. Optional.
